note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a CV 13(1); A06b CV 13(1); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship), A02a (birth in country: Parental residence restriction) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory only on the condition the dataset states; by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file. On 2026-11-03 the primary was read: Alta Autoridade para a Imigração (Cabo Verde), Nacionalidade Cabo-Verdiana. It confirmed the years of residence, renunciation, birth in the territory and descent. It was silent on loss on taking another citizenship, which still rests on the sources above, re-read that day and found the same. The Authority's page cites Lei 80/III/90 without naming its later amendments, and it differs from the dataset's 2024 coding at birth: it gives a child of foreigners born in Cabo Verde the option by declaration after five years' habitual residence, where the dataset gives it automatically after three, and a child born abroad an option to the grandparents. The page may predate an amendment and the law as amended wasn't reached, so the file keeps the dataset's figures at birth; the five years and no renunciation are the page's.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Cape Verde, 2024
sources.said: Person has been legally resident in Cape Verde for at least 5 years. ... n.a. ... n.a. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Cape Verde to a citizen. ... Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship ... Person is born abroad and one parent is a citizen in the service of the state; Person is born abroad and one parent is a citizen from birth. ... Parental residence restriction ... Person is born in Cape Verde to parents who have been legally resident for at least 3 years and are not in the service of another state, if person does not declare his or her wish not to be Cape Verdean. ... No provision

sources.title: Alta Autoridade para a Imigração (Cabo Verde), Nacionalidade Cabo-Verdiana
sources.said: De acordo com a Lei 80/III/90, de 29 de junho, ... É atribuída nacionalidade de origem por nascimento ao: Indivíduo nascido em Cabo Verde, filho de pai ou mãe de nacionalidade cabo-verdiana; Indivíduo nascido em território cabo-verdiano que não possua outra nacionalidade; ... Pode optar pela nacionalidade cabo-verdiana de origem, mediante declaração: O indivíduo nascido no estrangeiro de pai ou mãe, avô ou avó de nacionalidade cabo-verdiana por nascimento; O indivíduo nascido em Cabo Verde de pais estrangeiros, se estes residirem habitualmente em território cabo-verdiano há pelo menos cinco anos e nenhum deles aí se encontre ao serviço do respetivo Estado. ... Por naturalização - pode ser concedida a nacionalidade por naturalização ao estrangeiro que resida habitualmente em território cabo-verdiano há pelo menos cinco anos, ser considerado maior ou emancipado pelas leis do Estado de Cabo Verde, ter idoneidade moral ou civil, possuir capacidade para reger a sua pessoa e assegurar a sua subsistência.

atBirth.soilIf: Person is born in Cape Verde to parents who have been legally resident for at least 3 years and are not in the service of another state, if person does not declare his or her wish not to be Cape Verdean.
atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad and one parent is a citizen in the service of the state; Person is born abroad and one parent is a citizen from birth.
